# Blocksize Oracle Lineage & Rights Evidence Index

Evidence as of July 22, 2026. This is a product and sourcing control artifact, not legal advice.

## Executive Summary

The index covers **34 providers** and **34 distinct lineage groups**. For **25 providers**, a commercial redistribution grant is not stated in the reviewed public evidence. Public APIs, onchain contracts, and signed reports can establish technical access or provenance, but they do not by themselves grant Blocksize the right to redistribute the data.

## Key findings

Source categories span venues, oracle networks, issuers, commercial market-data partners, and infrastructure. Their values are not interchangeable: executable books, reference marks, issuer NAV, and oracle aggregates need different labels and quality gates.
Public documentation most often leaves commercial redistribution unstated or agreement-scoped. That is a diligence queue, not evidence that use is forbidden or granted.
Lineage groups prevent false source diversity. A vendor aggregate, its component venues, and a downstream oracle report cannot automatically be counted as independent confirmations of the same price.

## Recommended next steps

1. Attach executed contract or license references to each production source.
2. Keep executable, indicative, oracle, NAV, and derived price semantics explicit in every receipt.
3. Require lineage-group checks before consensus calculations.
4. Reconcile the internal policy register against external documentary evidence and counsel-approved decisions.

## Further questions

Which high-value providers can supply a written redistribution and signing grant? Which apparent independent sources share an upstream index, venue set, issuer NAV, or oracle aggregate?

## Caveats

The external matrix summarizes public materials and is not legal advice. The internal rights register is a policy-state input and may encode approvals not visible in public documentation; it must not be presented as an external contractual grant without the supporting agreement.

manifest.title: Blocksize Oracle Lineage & Rights Evidence Index

lineage_rows.decision_note: Strong executable candidate. Do not count HIP-3 oracle/index and native order book as independent sources; verify each market's deployer/oracle definition.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: hyperliquid_native_book; each HIP-3 dex and its deployer oracle must retain separate lineage
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Native L2 book and trades; separate allMids, oracle, mark, funding. HIP-3 deployer defines oracle and contract specs

lineage_rows.decision_note: Best build candidate because the book can be reconstructed and replayed from exact accounts/slots. Exclude indicative quotes from firm executable depth or cap separately.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: drift_dlob; vAMM and indicative-quote components must remain tagged and not counted as independent
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Locally reconstructed onchain DLOB L2/L3; committed resting orders; optional vAMM/fallback liquidity; separate oracle/mark. Indicative quotes are explicitly non-firm

lineage_rows.decision_note: Strong executable candidate. Implement snapshot+prevTs sequencing and preserve the shared-liquidity lineage across broker front ends.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: orderly_shared_clob; all front ends share the same liquidity and must not be counted as independent venues
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Shared offchain CLOB order book/trades; separate index, mark and funding

lineage_rows.decision_note: Useful reference/bid-ask candidate, but not native L2 and not independently sourced until its upstream oracle lineage is documented.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: ostium_protocol_quote; underlying oracle lineage must be mapped before independence claims
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Builder API exposes bid/mid/ask and market caps; no documented native L2. Treat any inferred depth as synthetic/protocol capacity, not order-book depth

lineage_rows.decision_note: Good high-frequency reference lane. Never label as BidAsk or block-size VWAP.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: gains_don_reference; do not treat pair price as venue book depth
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Protocol/DON reference prices and OHLC; not an executable order book

lineage_rows.decision_note: Executable candidate for listed instruments, but current RWA breadth and redistribution rights need confirmation.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: aevo_native_book; options and perps separate from external index/oracle lineage
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Native offchain order book/trades; instrument types PERPETUAL and OPTION; USD prices and contract amounts

lineage_rows.decision_note: Executable candidate. Pin V3 schema and capture exchangeInfo multipliers/ticks before coverage claims.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: aster_native_book; do not conflate Aster source with upstream oracle/index
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Public REST depth/trades/tickers/funding and WebSocket market streams; separate mark/index where exposed

lineage_rows.decision_note: High-coverage exact identity/reference lane. Preserve ISIN, underlying symbol, multiplier and halt state. No executable semantics or native timestamp should be invented.
lineage_rows.documented_rights_text: Unknown; integrator audience is not an express redistribution license
lineage_rows.lineage_group: backed_issuer_reference; every chain deployment/wrapper is one economic source
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Underlying reference price, token multiplier/contract metadata, corporate actions; soft/firm issuance-redemption quote endpoints separately authenticated. Public token payload is not L2 depth

lineage_rows.decision_note: Partner, do not scrape. Treat soft quote as non-binding and display price as reference-only.
lineage_rows.documented_rights_text: No for the documented display endpoints; explicit display-only wording
lineage_rows.lineage_group: ondo_issuer_primary; underlying market data and token primary price share issuer lineage
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Display-only latest/market/OHLC prices; separate non-binding soft quote and signed mint/redemption attestations; primary token price and underlying-market price distinguished

lineage_rows.decision_note: Not a lawful replacement input for Blocksize analytics/oracle under the cited US NBBO terms. Could be an execution/partner display lane only under a negotiated agreement.
lineage_rows.documented_rights_text: Only as licensed display through Dinari; not a general resale grant
lineage_rows.lineage_group: dinari_sip_or_dfn; official-exchange lineage, not independent from CTA/UTP or other SIP vendors
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Licensed NBBO bid/ask for pre-trade display; WebSocket draft lists DFN L2/top-of-book; Dinari says its standard feeds are official exchange data, not onchain dShare trading

lineage_rows.decision_note: Partner/API discovery required. Do not infer prices from token state or catalog metadata.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: swarm_platform; exact asset and venue/pool lineage required
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Platform/API and smart-contract solution for issuance/trading; no public price/NAV feed contract located in reviewed official docs

lineage_rows.decision_note: Use as issuer/TA integration, not as a generic price provider. Request exact NAV/webhook fields and rights per fund.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: securitize_transfer_agent_or_issuer; NAV may originate with each fund administrator
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Connect/Domain APIs cover identity, wallets, tokens and investment flows; no general public market-price/NAV feed found

lineage_rows.decision_note: High-value partner target: official identifiers and NAV history exist. Keep official NAV separate from 24/7 dealer quote/executable price.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: wisdomtree_official_nav; dealer execution and official NAV are distinct semantics but same issuer family
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Official daily NAV, shares, AUM, accruals, performance and holdings; separate subscription/redemption/order workflows and WTGXX 24/7 dealer settlement

lineage_rows.decision_note: Authoritative NAV candidate, not independent twice when read from both Spiko and Chainlink contracts.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: spiko_caceis_nav; Spiko relayer and Chainlink publication are correlated representations of the same CACEIS NAV
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Official NAV calculated daily by CACEIS; onchain Oracle/Chainlink AggregatorV3-compatible feed; NAV is not market BidAsk

lineage_rows.decision_note: Strong authoritative NAV/redemption-rate lane. Label continuous price as extrapolated NAV, not an exchange price.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: superstate_nav; continuous extrapolation and daily Chainlink/Pyth representations remain one issuer-NAV lineage
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Daily NAV/AUM/yield API; USTB continuous price extrapolated from latest two NAV checkpoints; daily Chainlink NAV/S; onchain redemption/subscription calculators

lineage_rows.decision_note: Partner for official NAV/TA data. Token balance and daily yield minting are not standalone market prices.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: franklin_transfer_agent_nav; all chain deployments are one fund/TA source
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Official fund share record; BENJI represents a fund share and accrues yield; no public executable quote/book or public NAV API schema located

lineage_rows.decision_note: Authoritative NAV candidate only. Preserve valuation date and do not infer continuous executable liquidity from 24/7 contract settlement.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: openeden_fund_nav; administrator report and onchain oracle are one fund lineage
lineage_rows.price_semantics: NAV per token; onchain price oracle used for subscriptions; daily/monthly administrator NAV; no executable market depth

lineage_rows.decision_note: Reference/primary quote candidate after exact contract mapping. Website quote is not evidence of API/redistribution rights.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: matrixdock_issuer_quote; external Chainlink XAU/USD or SmartData may be upstream and must be tagged
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Issuer mint/redeem quote and reserve/transparency data; XAUm unit is one troy ounce; no public general price API found

lineage_rows.decision_note: Useful exact redemption/reference lane. Keep explicit disclaimer that oracle is reference and redemption amount may differ.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: midas_reference_oracle; verification agent and issuer oracle are not separate price sources
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Issuer/reference-value oracle; daily independent verification; instant redemption uses designated oracle price but issuer redemption amount may differ

lineage_rows.decision_note: Good reference/guardrail input, not block-size VWAP. Treat publisher count as robustness metadata, not accessible independent inputs.
lineage_rows.documented_rights_text: Unknown for a commercial offchain API built from Pyth
lineage_rows.lineage_group: pyth_aggregate; one Pyth feed counts as one lineage regardless of publisher count; do not count NOBI/TTMzero separately without publisher-level observations
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Robust aggregate price plus confidence; not executable depth. Publisher contributions aggregated on Pythnet; market hours/status matter

lineage_rows.decision_note: Potential partner substitute for client-used TradFi symbols, but obtain written redistribution, raw retention and onchain-publication rights. Experimental bid/ask is not production depth.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: pyth_pro_aggregate; correlated with Pyth Core where same publisher set/instrument
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Aggregate price/confidence/publisherCount; optional experimental best bid/ask; market-session state; signed EVM/Solana payloads; funding-rate feed types

lineage_rows.decision_note: Do not infer how NOBI licenses or derives TradFi data. Public evidence does not establish reproducible upstream lineage or copyable rights.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: nobi_proprietary; if observed only inside Pyth aggregate, cannot be counted separately
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Publisher claims real-time feeds and 24/7 commodity coverage; Pyth announced NOBI contributes proprietary data. Exact aggregation and upstream construction are not public

lineage_rows.decision_note: Plausible partner for evaluated TradFi prices, but methodology, source list, licenses and rights are contract-specific. Do not copy or infer upstream arrangements.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: ttmzero_evaluated; Pyth observation is not independent from direct TTMzero for overlapping instruments
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Model-driven evaluated prices/indications and valuations; TTMzero says it has direct access to major exchanges, broker platforms and interbank markets

lineage_rows.decision_note: Strong reference/NAV source. Never label as executable; verify heartbeat, deviation, session and deprecation state per exact feed.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: chainlink_aggregate; SmartData/NAV must keep issuer administrator lineage; multiple chain deployments are not independent
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Aggregated market-representative reference or issuer/fundamental/hybrid SmartData; push heartbeat/deviation; not executable depth

lineage_rows.decision_note: Partner candidate, not a rights shortcut. Obtain precise instrument list, session logic, retention and redistribution/onchain publication rights.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: chainlink_streams; correlated with Chainlink feeds if overlapping upstreams
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Low-latency pull reports; prices, market status and some liquidity-weighted bid/ask; not a full L2 book

lineage_rows.decision_note: Potential RWA/oracle partner. Marketing claims do not disclose exact upstreams or license rights; require contract and methodology schedule.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: redstone_aggregate; custom feed and issuer NAV lineage must be preserved
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Push/pull oracle reference; RedStone Live claims institutionally sourced, asset-specific weighted composites; not native L2

lineage_rows.decision_note: Reference candidate only. Pair coverage and rights must be verified under early-access agreement.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: supra_aggregate; source identities not exposed in aggregate
lineage_rows.price_semantics: DORA S-value: node medians clustered then mean; push/pull onchain reference; REST/WebSocket API includes real-time/historical crypto/OHLC

lineage_rows.decision_note: Low-cost reference candidate on EVM. Account for deliberate base-feed delay and exact provider set; not executable.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: api3_beacon_set; each API provider can be lineage-tagged, but an aggregate dAPI is one composite
lineage_rows.price_semantics: First-party API-provider signed beacons/beacon sets; base updates may be delayed 0-20 s for OEV; reference price not depth

lineage_rows.decision_note: Good for custom onchain publication plumbing, not a substitute for upstream rights. Exact job definition and sources are mandatory.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: switchboard_feed; custom job upstreams must be disclosed before independence claims
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Permissionless customizable pull feed/TEEs; standard ~400 ms oracle and 2-5 ms paid Surge claims; reference values, not executable depth

lineage_rows.decision_note: Use only after legal review: current terms retain data-feed rights and restrict scraping/competitive use. Native integration differs from commercial redistribution.
lineage_rows.lineage_group: chronicle_aggregate; source identities/quality tier should remain attached
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Scribe onchain reference; dashboard labels market, fundamental or hybrid price type and risk tier; not executable depth

lineage_rows.decision_note: Best price-screen partner candidate for the client-used universe, but 11,472 symbols exceed advertised 10,000 WebSocket credits and commercial API redistribution/onchain publication remain quote and agreement gates. Default feed is not SIP/NBBO or executable full depth.
lineage_rows.documented_rights_text: Separate Redistribution Rights Add-On or written agreement required; full-market licensed access is quote required
lineage_rows.lineage_group: twelve_data_default_us_venue_set or licensed_full_market_upstream; do not count the vendor and its component venues as independent without lineage
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Trade/quote/reference API data; default US feed is representative rather than consolidated full-market NBBO or L2 depth

lineage_rows.decision_note: Technically strong depth/replay partner, but current full US Equities price equals the assumed avoided subscription before extra rights. Use as benchmark for negotiations, not a demonstrated savings path.
lineage_rows.documented_rights_text: Plus advertises external distribution, subject to dataset/exchange licensing and actual questionnaire fees
lineage_rows.lineage_group: databento_dataset_plus_underlying_venues; a vendor composite is not independent from its licensed venue inputs
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Dataset-dependent trades, MBP/L1-L3 books and historical replay; exact semantics depend on schema and licensed dataset

lineage_rows.decision_note: Low-cost managed transport candidate for pilots. Select by measured request, log/archive, WebSocket, gRPC, storage and egress load; retain a second RPC for failover before production.
lineage_rows.documented_rights_text: Not a grant to redistribute upstream market data
lineage_rows.lineage_group: quicknode_rpc_transport; preserve the underlying chain/protocol lineage
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Transport for exact onchain state; RPC metadata is not a price

lineage_rows.decision_note: Economical secondary or usage-based RPC candidate. Benchmark real method mix and Solana gRPC/egress before selecting; use independent transport for failover.
lineage_rows.documented_rights_text: Not a grant to redistribute upstream market data
lineage_rows.lineage_group: alchemy_rpc_transport; preserve the underlying chain/protocol lineage
lineage_rows.price_semantics: Transport for exact onchain state; RPC responses, balances and logs are not prices without a named pricing contract/pool simulation

query.description: Provider-by-provider review of price semantics, access, public rights evidence, lineage, and official sources.
query.sql: SELECT provider, category, price_semantics, lineage_group, commercial_redistribution_rights, decision_note, official_sources FROM official_source_rights_lineage_matrix

query.description: Internal policy and readiness state, kept separate from public documentary evidence.
query.sql: SELECT provider_id, rights_status, production_access_ready, can_redistribute_production FROM internal_source_rights_register
